data.title: Electricity contract confirmation "MusterStrom Flex"
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH confirmed your electricity supply contract "MusterStrom Flex" for Beispielweg 5, starting 1 October 2025 with a 12-month initial term. The monthly advance payment is €48.00, due on the 15th.
data.explanation: This confirms your new electricity contract. It runs 12 months from 1 October 2025 (to 30 September 2026). You can cancel with one month's notice to the end of the initial term. If you don't cancel, it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The app calculates the cancellation deadline. Since the initial term is ending, check the deadline shown if you want to switch or leave. The €48.00 advance payment is collected by direct debit on the 15th of each month. The meter reading at delivery start was due by 5 October 2025.
